controles.affirmation: Judiciaire : en juillet 2021 FE a accepte le depot d'un chef de complot en vue de commettre une fraude par fil portant atteinte aux services honnetes (HB 6), amende penale de 230 M$ ; obligations du DPA remplies au 22 juillet 2024 ; obligations de transparence continues (publication trimestrielle des versements aux entites 501(c)(4)) ; deux anciens dirigeants mis en examen en janvier 2025 sur la base des faits decrits dans le DPA
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "On July 21, 2021, FE entered into a three-year DPA with the U.S. Attorney's Office [...] Under the DPA, FE agreed to the filing of a criminal information charging FE with one count of conspiracy to commit honest services wire fraud" ; "pay a criminal monetary penalty totaling $230 million within sixty days" ; "As of July 22, 2024, FirstEnergy had successfully completed the obligations required within the three-year term of the DPA" ; "On January 17, 2025, the U.S. Attorney's Office announced that a federal grand jury charged two former FirstEnergy senior officers with one count of participating in a Racketeer Influenced and Corrupt Organizations Act conspiracy. The allegations in the indictment are largely based on the conduct described in the DPA."
controles.correction_proposee: Trois precisions : (a) le document dit "largely based on the conduct described in the DPA", l'ATT ecrit "sur la base des faits decrits dans le DPA" en supprimant "largely" ; (b) dater au 17 janvier 2025 ; (c) mentionner le chef retenu, une conspiration RICO, que l'ATT omet.

controles.affirmation: L'accord judiciaire de la societe est solde / FirstEnergy a rempli en 2024 toutes les obligations de son accord de poursuite differee
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "Under the DPA, FirstEnergy has an obligation to continue: (i) publishing quarterly a list of all payments to 501(c)(4) entities [...] and (iv) cooperating with the U.S. Attorney's Office until the conclusion of any related investigation, criminal prosecution, and civil proceeding brought by the U.S. Attorney's Office, including the aforementioned federal indictment against two former FirstEnergy senior officers. Within 30 days of those matters concluding, and FirstEnergy's successful completion of its remaining obligations, the U.S. Attorney's Office will dismiss the criminal information."
controles.correction_proposee: Le chef d'accusation penal (criminal information) contre FirstEnergy N'EST PAS abandonne : sa levee est suspendue a la fin des poursuites contre les deux ex-dirigeants et a l'execution des obligations restantes. Ecrire : "FirstEnergy a rempli les obligations du terme de trois ans, mais le chef d'accusation penal reste depose : il ne sera abandonne que 30 jours apres la cloture des poursuites contre les deux ex-dirigeants." Omission distincte et materielle : le 10-Q indique pour In re FirstEnergy Corp. Securities Litigation (classe recertifiee le 30 avril 2026) que "FE believes that it is probable that it will incur a loss in connection with the resolution of this lawsuit [...] FE cannot yet reasonably estimate a loss or range of loss" - une perte jugee probable et non chiffrable, absente de l'ATT.

controles.affirmation: Reglementaire : la loi HB 15, entree en vigueur le 14 aout 2025, abroge le statut ESP en Ohio et met fin a l'obligation de reexamen quadriennal
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "On May 15, 2025, the Ohio Governor signed HB 15, which repealed the statute authorizing ESPs in Ohio, effective August 14, 2025. On December 17, 2025, the PUCO dismissed the Ohio Companies' application for ESP VI due to the repeal of the ESP statute." ; "HB 15 ending the statutory mandate to conduct the quadrennial review, effective August 14, 2025"

controles.affirmation: Le cadre ESP regissait FirstEnergy en Ohio "depuis vingt ans" / "depuis deux decennies"
controles.verbatim_source: Aucune duree n'est mentionnee dans le 10-Q T2 2026. La formule provient de data-lake/FE/risks/extracted.json : "La loi HB 15 abroge le statut ESP qui fondait le cadre tarifaire de FirstEnergy depuis 20 ans", extraction derivee non etayee par le filing.
controles.correction_proposee: Le statut ESP a ete cree par la loi ohioane SB 221 en 2008 et abroge le 14 aout 2025, soit 17 ans. Ecrire "depuis 2008" plutot qu'une duree arrondie non sourcee.

controles.affirmation: En 2025 la PUCO a impose une charge de depreciation de 352 M$ liee au dossier tarifaire ESP IV
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "On May 31, 2024, the Ohio Companies filed their application for an increase in base distribution rates based on a 2024 calendar year test period. On November 19, 2025, the PUCO issued an order in the rate case [...] As a result of the order, the Ohio Companies recognized a $352 million pre-tax impairment charge related to future recovery disallowances of certain previously capitalized amounts."
controles.correction_proposee: La charge decoule de l'ordonnance du 19 novembre 2025 dans le dossier de TARIFS DE DISTRIBUTION DE BASE, pas du dossier ESP IV, qui est une procedure distincte. Ecrire : "une charge de depreciation avant impot de 352 M$ resultant de l'ordonnance PUCO du 19 novembre 2025 dans le dossier de tarifs de distribution de base". Erreur heritee de data-lake/FE/risks/extracted.json, qui ecrit deja "liee au dossier tarifaire Ohio ESP IV".

controles.affirmation: Un accord de restitution de 275 M$ (213 M$ apres impots) aux clients, remboursement etale sur trois cycles de facturation depuis fevrier 2026
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "On January 7, 2026, the PUCO issued an order, which directed the Ohio Companies to pay their customers, among other things, restitution and refunds totaling approximately $275 million ($213 million after-tax), which was recognized in the fourth quarter of 2025. The restitution and refunds are being provided to customers over three billing cycles, which began in February 2026. As of June 30, 2026, the Ohio Companies have issued approximately $266 million in restitution and refunds."
controles.correction_proposee: Ce n'est pas un "accord" mais une ORDONNANCE du regulateur : la PUCO a ordonne le 7 janvier 2026 aux societes ohioanes de payer. Requalifier en "restitution de 275 M$ ordonnee par la PUCO". Les montants et le calendrier sont exacts ; ajouter que 266 M$ etaient deja verses au 30 juin 2026.

controles.affirmation: Chiffre 1 : dette nette 28,92 Mds$ au 30/06/2026 (+14,5% sur un an), fonds propres 12,94 Mds$ (+0,7%) ; dette LT 27 102 M$ contre 25 508 M$ ; charges d'interets 337 M$ (+12,7%) contre resultat net 288 M$ (+7,5%)
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "Long-term debt and other long-term obligations | 27,102 | 25,508" ; "Interest expense | (337) | (299)" ; "EARNINGS ATTRIBUTABLE TO FIRSTENERGY CORP. | $288 | $268" ; .batches-drafts-safe/kpis-haut/FE.json : net_debt 28.92 Mds$ yoy +14.5% (derive : 27 102 + 505 + 1 376 - 63), equity 12.94 Mds$ yoy +0.7% ("Balance, June 30, 2026 | Total Common Stockholders' Equity | 12,935"), interest_expense_q 337 +12.7%, net_income_q 288 +7.5%

controles.affirmation: Chiffre 2 : plan Energize365 2026-2030 de 36 Mds$, environ 25% de plus que le plan 2025-2029 ; FCF trimestriel -356 M$ (-161,8%) ; OCF 989 M$ (-8,6%)
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "Energize365 investment plan for the 2026 to 2030 time period is $36 billion, approximately 25% higher than the previous 2025 to 2029 five-year plan" ; .batches-drafts-safe/kpis-haut/FE.json : fcf_q -356 M$ yoy -161.8% ("989 - 1 345 = -356 M$"), ocf_q 989 M$ yoy -8.6%

controles.affirmation: Chiffre 3 : achats d'energie 1 157 M$ au T2 2026 (+21,4%), la marge energetique trimestrielle recule de 3,7 POINTS sur un an, a 64,3%
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, compte de resultat : "Total revenues 3,678 | 3,380" ; "Fuel 156 | 168" ; "Purchased power 1,157 | 953". Marge energetique T2 2025 = (3 380 - 953 - 168)/3 380 = 66,8% ; T2 2026 = (3 678 - 1 157 - 156)/3 678 = 64,3%. L'ecart est de 2,5 POINTS. Le "-3.7%" du champ yoy de kpis-haut est une variation RELATIVE (64,3/66,8 - 1 = -3,7%), pas un ecart en points.
controles.correction_proposee: Ecrire "la marge energetique recule de 2,5 points sur un an, de 66,8% a 64,3% (soit -3,7% en relatif)". Les achats d'energie a +21,4% sont exacts (1 157 contre 953 M$).

controles.verbatim_source: data-lake/FE/risks/extracted.json, risque Operational "Perturbations de la chaine d'approvisionnement et risques tarifaires" (source declaree : 10-K FY2025). Absent du 10-Q T2 2026, mais l'ATT cite bien l'extraction des risques comme source pour ce point.
